<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;double&nbsp;calculateJamFactor()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Calculates the traffic jam factor that shows the traffic condition in a numeric way.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>Returns calculated jam factor in the range [0.0, 10.0].
     A large jamFactor value means more traffic jam in general.
     Specifically, 0.0 means free traffic and 10.0 means stationary traffic.</dd>
